recheck.rule: per kind, over the glue-used chunks: chunk chosen iff int(sha256(NAME).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 100 == 0 (NAME = the chunk module name, ASCII, as in checkd's chunk= field), topped up to ceil(n/100) by the lowest such hashes; its items regenerated exactly and the chunk re-run with NNODYNLIB=1 (Lean IR interpreter); the olean sha256 must equal the recorded one (byte-identical)
recheck.note: time-boxed: every chosen chunk stays queued in a fixed order (no substitution); the chunks completed by the deadline count, so the completed set is biased toward smaller chunks; the rest keep running and are reported in the repository; any mismatch stops the release
